cd954912be25bf83872c.en: Plants have different parts. Each part has a job.
cd954912be25bf83872c.id: Tumbuhan punya bagian yang berbeda-beda. Setiap bagian punya tugas.

e56eb611410b88b59cab.en: The roots grow under the soil. They hold the plant and take in water.
e56eb611410b88b59cab.id: Akar (roots) tumbuh di bawah tanah. Akar menahan tumbuhan dan menyerap air.

618c6a1b46d33d27b688.en: The stem holds the plant up. It carries water to the leaves.
618c6a1b46d33d27b688.id: Batang (stem) menopang tumbuhan supaya tetap tegak. Batang mengangkut air ke daun.

4d9e8868aa1f60ce24a9.en: Leaves are often green and flat. They use light to make food.
4d9e8868aa1f60ce24a9.id: Daun sering berwarna hijau dan pipih. Daun memakai cahaya untuk membuat makanan.

0f40827bd35d1d19ff80.en: The flower makes seeds. New plants grow from the seeds.
0f40827bd35d1d19ff80.id: Bunga menghasilkan biji. Tumbuhan baru tumbuh dari biji itu.
